description: This file defines the LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping class, which extends Symfony's ParameterBag to handle LDAP employee attribute mappings, including creation from an array, conversion to array, and extraction of attribute values from LDAP entries.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping
classes.description: A class that manages LDAP employee attribute mappings, allowing creation from arrays, extracting attribute values, and providing attribute name lists.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all stored LDAP attribute mappings as an array.

methods.name: getAllAttributeNames
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute names from the stored mappings.

methods.name: extractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParam
methods.description: Extracts attribute values from an LDAP Entry to populate an LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams object.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance of LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping from an array, validating fields.
